summary: Rewrite AI drafts in your own voice with a bounded TypeSafe feedback loop.
summary_zh: 用有界反馈循环把 AI 草稿改写成你自己的语气。

title: jevticktrouter
summary: A .NET 10 and React 19 application for fast, structured AI-powered ticket triage using TypeSafe Jev.
summary_zh: 用 .NET 10 与 React 19 做的快速结构化工单分拣。

title: jevseo
summary: Typed SEO, AEO and GEO judgments powered by Jev, a System One decision model. Code owns the rules, the model owns the meaning.
summary_zh: 由 Jev 驱动的类型化 SEO／AEO／GEO 判断，代码掌管其余。

title: check-risk
summary: A CLI and GitHub Action that assesses code-change risk using deterministic rules and TypeSafe Jev, recommending checks and reviewers before merge.
summary_zh: 用确定性规则加 Jev 评估代码变更风险的 CLI 与 GitHub Action。

title: jev-playwright-mcp
summary: Jev-augmented Playwright MCP proxy — page-state triage, prompt-injection shielding, goal-based snapshot pruning, risky-action gating. Drop-in wrapper around @playwright/mcp for any coding agent.
summary_zh: Jev 增强的 Playwright MCP 代理：页面状态分拣与提示注入防护。

title: cyber-breach-jev
summary: Cyber-Breach: The Jev Protocol - A tactical cyberpunk arena combat game powered by TypeSafe AI Jev System One decision model
summary_zh: 由 Jev 驱动的赛博朋克竞技场战斗游戏。

title: hunch
summary: Semantic code review with Jev, plain-English rules and Agent Skills.
summary_zh: 用 Jev、大白话规则与 Agent 技能做语义代码审查。

title: typesafe-jev-drone-demo
summary: Three.js drone simulator with a Python backend and live TypeSafe Jev navigation
summary_zh: Three.js 无人机模拟器，Python 后端加 Jev 实时导航。

title: secondlayer
summary: Decoded Stacks data in your own database. Self-hosted.
summary_zh: 把解码后的链上数据放进你自己的数据库，可自托管。

title: jev-plays-pokemon
summary: Playing Pokemon Red using TypeSafe Jev
summary_zh: 用 Jev 玩《宝可梦红》。

title: open-jev-approvals
summary: Binary approval gate for Codex and Claude Code — every intercepted tool call is reviewed by TypeSafe JEV and composed through a versioned local policy, with scoped authorization.
summary_zh: 给 Codex 与 Claude Code 的二值批准闸门：每次被拦截的工具调用都要审查。
notes: Self-describes as an alternative or reimplementation. The call site found may be an evaluation baseline rather than the product. A compatible wire format implies nothing about compatible calibration.
notes_zh: 自述为替代品或复现实现。扫描到的调用点可能只是评测基线而非产品本身。协议兼容不代表校准兼容。

title: jev-browser-pilot
summary: A bounded decision layer for browser and desktop automation: a decision-only model picks one next step; the code owns perception, content, actuation and verification.
summary_zh: 给浏览器与桌面自动化的有界决策层：只做决策的模型负责选择。

title: jev-tool-router
summary: Jev-powered MCP tool routing for Codex
summary_zh: 给 Codex 的 Jev 驱动 MCP 工具路由。

title: jev-compaction
summary: Context compaction for Hermes sessions that never summarises: every tool call is scored by TypeSafe's Jev model, stale calls are dropped, everything kept stays verbatim.
summary_zh: 从不做摘要的 Hermes 会话上下文压缩：每次工具调用都被打分。

title: decide-mcp
summary: Configurable decision MCP server with AI SDK, Jev, percentage scores, and bias profile routing
summary_zh: 可配置的决策 MCP server，带百分比分数与偏好画像。

title: your-signal
summary: Open-source BYOK Chrome extension for personal, reversible X timeline filters.
summary_zh: 开源的自带密钥 Chrome 扩展：个人化、可撤销的 X 时间线过滤。

title: jev-tool-permissions
summary: Jev-backed tool approval gate and tool-list pruning for the Vercel AI SDK
summary_zh: 给 Vercel AI SDK 的 Jev 工具批准闸门与工具列表裁剪。

title: jev-chat-for-twitch
summary: Filter any live Twitch chat with Jev: a bring-your-own-key Chrome extension
summary_zh: 用 Jev 过滤任意 Twitch 直播聊天的自带密钥 Chrome 扩展。

title: azdaja
summary: Minimal harness-agnostic recursive language model layer — one binary, Python + llm()
summary_zh: 与 harness 无关的极简递归语言模型层：单个二进制。

title: profanity-checker
summary: Cloudflare Worker to check for profanity using TypeSafe Jev
summary_zh: 用 Jev 检查脏话的 Cloudflare Worker。

title: typesafe-ai-ruby
summary: Ruby client for the TypeSafe AI(Jev) System One API
summary_zh: System One API 的 Ruby 客户端。

title: openrouter-jev-mcp
summary: High-speed System One Jev AI decision gateway and MCP server powered by OpenRouter
summary_zh: 由 OpenRouter 驱动的高速 System One 决策网关与 MCP server。

title: jev-broadcast-lab
summary: Testing Lab for Jev AI
summary_zh: Jev 的测试实验室。

title: fast-compaction-dsh
summary: Verdict-based context compaction for DeepSeek Harness — replaces lossy LLM summaries with fast keep/truncate/drop decisions from jev-latest; everything kept stays verbatim. Port of tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction.
summary_zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的判定式上下文压缩，取代有损的 LLM 摘要。

title: jev-robotics-demo
summary: Jev (TypeSafe System One) vs Claude Opus 5 driving a simulated robot arm in MuJoCo
summary_zh: Jev 对比某大模型：在 MuJoCo 里驾驶仿真机械臂。

title: jev-decision-lab
summary: A local lab for seeing what TypeSafe's Jev judgment model does on realistic business cases: typed answers, probabilities, policy in code, receipts.
summary_zh: 一个本地实验室，观察 Jev 在真实业务场景上的判断表现。

title: jevgraph
summary: Evidence-backed knowledge graph construction with typed Jev relation decisions
summary_zh: 用类型化 Jev 关系决策构建有证据支撑的知识图谱。

title: jev-sim
summary: Jev-compatible /v1/systemone server reading typed decisions from LLM logits, benchmarked against TypeSafe's Jev on the same items via JevBench
summary_zh: 从 LLM logits 读出类型化决策的 Jev 兼容 /v1/systemone 服务，带基准。

title: jev-llm-router-benchmark
summary: Benchmark-driven Jev router and judge for cost-aware, reliable LLM coding workflows
summary_zh: 以基准驱动的 Jev 路由器与评判者，服务于成本可控的 LLM 编程流程。

title: jev-demo
summary: Jev (TypeSafe System One) 学习与实测：概念文档 + 5 个可运行 demo + 可复现压测。实测 jev-1.13.0：扇出几乎免费，40 问与 1 问等延迟。
summary_zh: Jev 学习与实测：概念文档、5 个可运行 demo 与可复现压测 —— 实测扇出几乎免费。

title: jev-torneo-animales
summary: Winner-stays-on animal tournament refereed by Jev (TypeSafe System One): a local game to feel how fast typed decisions are. UI in Spanish.
summary_zh: 由 Jev 裁判的擂台式动物锦标赛，本地游戏。

title: cultivar
summary: Use cultivar to test your Agent Skills and Docs by running them in sandboxes, and across different agents.
summary_zh: 在沙盒里跨环境测试你的 Agent 技能与文档。

title: pi-jev-skill-picker
summary: Rank Pi Agent Skills for the current task with TypeSafe Jev
summary_zh: 用 Jev 给当前任务的 Pi Agent 技能排序。

title: jev-synthetic-survey
summary: Jev vs GPT-4.1 as synthetic survey respondents on Twin-2K-500. How you ask mattered more than which model you used.
summary_zh: 把 Jev 与 GPT-4.1 当作合成问卷受访者做对比 —— 怎么问比用哪个模型更重要。

title: stuntdouble
summary: A drop-in /v1/systemone proxy: the app keeps calling Jev while local decision models answer the same requests in the shadow, then it reports whether they would have decided the same — per question, per confidence band, at the app's own decide() — plus Brier, ECE, latency and cost.
summary_zh: 一个即插即用的 /v1/systemone 代理：应用照常调用 Jev，本地决策模型在影子里回答同样的请求，再报告它们是否会做出同样的决策 —— 按问题、按置信区间、按应用自己的 decide() 分别统计，并给出 Brier、ECE、延迟与成本。回答“能不能换成本地模型”这个问题。
notes: Submitted by its own author, who disclosed the AI assistance; the flag records that disclosure. Jev's reply to the app is never altered or delayed by the doubles — a test enforces it. It forwards whichever primitives the app asks. The committed launch report compares two local models with each other: no key was available, so Jev itself has not been run through it yet.
notes_zh: 由作者本人投稿，并主动披露了 AI 协助；这个标记记录的是这份披露。影子模型永远不会改变或拖慢 Jev 回给应用的结果 —— 有测试保证。应用问什么原语它就转发什么。仓库里的首发报告比较的是两个本地模型：当时没有 key，所以 Jev 本身还没真正跑过这套流程。

title: jgrep (npm: jevgrep)
summary: grep for what code does: one Noul per code chunk, diff hunk or CSV row, printed as file:line hits with probabilities. --diff gates a PR in CI on a rule written in English (exit 0 match / 1 clean / 2 error); --tests lists the test files a diff can affect.
summary_zh: 按代码的作用来 grep：对每个代码块、diff 块或 CSV 行问一个 Noul，输出带概率的 file:line 命中。--diff 用一条英文规则在 CI 里为 PR 把关（退出码 0 命中 / 1 干净 / 2 出错）；--tests 列出一次 diff 可能影响的测试文件。
notes: Self-submission by the maintainer. The text of every searched chunk, diff hunk or row is sent to TypeSafe's API; TypeSafe endpoint only, no OpenRouter. Code and diff modes call Noul only; --rows passes Choice and Score questions through verbatim. Timings and costs in the README are author-reported. Answers are cached locally by (model, question, chunk).
notes_zh: 维护者自荐。所搜索的每个代码块、diff 块或行的文本都会发送到 TypeSafe 的 API；仅支持 TypeSafe 端点，不支持 OpenRouter。代码与 diff 模式只调用 Noul；--rows 会原样传入 Choice 和 Score 问题。README 中的耗时和费用为作者自测。答案按（模型、问题、代码块）缓存在本地。

title: jevsearch
summary: A shadcn/ui ⌘K site-search block: a local keyword pass shows hits at once, then the top 20 go to Jev in one request (a Noul per candidate, a Choice for the best page, a Noul for whether any page answers) and are re-ordered or dropped; keyword order stands if TypeSafe is slow or down.
summary_zh: shadcn/ui 的 ⌘K 站内搜索组件：先用本地关键词匹配立即出结果，再把前 20 条一次性发给 Jev（每个候选一个 Noul、一个选出最佳页面的 Choice、一个判断是否有页面能回答的 Noul），据此重排或剔除结果；TypeSafe 变慢或不可用时保留关键词排序。
notes: The README's Hit@1 figures (83% vs 41% for its keyword pass alone, 41 labelled queries over the TypeSafe docs) come from the author's own benchmark in bench/results.json, not an independent run.
notes_zh: README 中的 Hit@1 数字（在 TypeSafe 文档上 41 条标注查询，83% 对比纯关键词的 41%）来自作者自己在 bench/results.json 里的评测，并非独立复现。

title: JevPDF
summary: Searches a PDF by meaning. pdf.js extracts each page's lines in the browser and Jev answers one Noul per line ("does this line answer the query?"), at most 16 lines per request with the page text as shared state. Lines at p ≥ 0.55 are highlighted in probability order; only text is sent to Jev.
summary_zh: 按语义搜索 PDF：pdf.js 在浏览器里逐页提取文本行，Jev 对每一行回答一个 Noul（“这一行是否回答了查询？”），每批最多 16 行、共享整页文本作为 state；概率不低于 0.55 的行被高亮并按概率排序。只发送文本，API key 由服务端代理持有。

title: Codex Jev Router
summary: Uses Jev Choice and Noul judgments on short task summaries to select a Codex subagent model and reasoning effort with a Sol fallback.
summary_zh: 使用 Jev 的 Choice 和 Noul 判断简短任务摘要，为 Codex 子代理选择模型与推理档位；不确定时回退到 Sol。
notes: Instruction-driven Codex subagent routing; no tool-boundary enforcement or measured savings are claimed. Hosted Jev needs a key and receives the sanitized task summary. Its author disclosed that it was built with Codex assistance and that a Codex agent prepared this submission; the flag records that disclosure, not a defect.
notes_zh: 作者主动披露：项目在 Codex 协助下开发，本次投稿由 Codex 代理准备；该标记记录的是这份披露，不是缺陷。

title: jev-belay
summary: Claude Code Stop hook that blocks an unverified done: reads the transcript for evidence, asks Jev once, fails open on everything else
summary_zh: Claude Code 的 Stop 钩子：在未经验证的“完成”之前拦下——读取会话记录找证据，只问 Jev 一次，其余情况一律放行。

title: jev-trade
summary: Live Jev trader on Hyperliquid
summary_zh: 在 Hyperliquid 上实盘运行的 Jev 交易机器人。

title: jev-plays-pokemon-red
summary: Pokemon Red on PyBoy: code owns the route and the arithmetic, Jev picks at branches in about 100 ms, calibration measured instead of assumed
summary_zh: 在 PyBoy 上玩《宝可梦 红》：路线和算术交给代码，Jev 在分叉点约 100 毫秒做出选择，校准是实测的而不是假设的。

title: jev.nvim
summary: Neovim: ask the buffer a question, get a quickfix list. Treesitter splits functions, Jev scores each one, probabilities land as virtual text
summary_zh: Neovim 插件：向当前缓冲区提问，得到 quickfix 列表。Treesitter 切分函数，Jev 给每个函数打分，概率以虚拟文本显示。

title: von
summary: The open-source System One decision model. Sub-15ms, non-autoregressive, local drop-in alternative to TypeSafe Jev.
summary_zh: 开源的 System One 决策模型：非自回归、15 毫秒以内，可在本地替换 TypeSafe Jev。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: laya
summary: Non-autoregressive System 1 decision engine. Typed choice, score and yes/no decisions over any text in a single forward pass, in 100+ languages, with a router that picks the right checkpoint per request.
summary_zh: 非自回归的 System 1 决策引擎：一次前向传播即可对任意文本给出 choice、score 与是非判断，支持 100 多种语言，并按请求路由到合适的检查点。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: jev-browser
summary: Browser automation where an LLM plans and Jev (Typesafe System One) decides. Library, CLI and MCP server.
summary_zh: 浏览器自动化：LLM 负责规划，Jev（TypeSafe System One）负责决策。提供库、CLI 和 MCP 服务器。

title: jevonian
summary: A local endpoint between a coding agent and its providers that routes each turn to the most cost-effective capable model, manages quota and cache, and logs every routing decision to a local ledger.
summary_zh: 位于编码智能体与各模型提供方之间的本地端点：把每一轮路由到性价比最高且能胜任的模型，管理配额与缓存，并把每次路由决策记入本地账本。

title: JEV-Paper-Radar
summary: Let Jev read every new arXiv paper each morning and surface the few you should read. Plain-English interests, calibrated probabilities, ~$0.06/day, fork and go.
summary_zh: 让 Jev 每天早上读完 arXiv 的新论文，挑出少数值得你读的几篇。用自然语言描述兴趣，输出校准概率，每天约 0.06 美元，fork 即用。

title: stuntd
summary: Local proxy that learns your app's typed LLM decisions and answers them with a Laya head. Jev and OpenAI compatible.
summary_zh: 本地代理：学习应用里带类型的 LLM 决策，并用一个 Laya 头来回答。兼容 Jev 与 OpenAI 接口。

title: typesafe-ai-rails
summary: Community Rails integration for TypeSafe AI's System One API on the community typesafe-sdk gem: Rails configuration, persisted usage and cost telemetry, and an opt-in confidence policy for Choice and Score answers.
summary_zh: TypeSafe AI System One API 的社区版 Rails 集成，基于社区 typesafe-sdk gem：提供 Rails 配置、持久化的用量与成本记录，以及针对 Choice 和 Score 答案的可选置信度策略。

title: jev-go
summary: Go client for TypeSafe's System One API and its model Jev: typed judgments and calibrated probabilities instead of generated text
summary_zh: TypeSafe System One API 及其模型 Jev 的 Go 客户端：返回带类型的判断与校准概率，而不是生成文本。

title: jev-search-rerank-eval
summary: Does a TypeSafe Jev rerank beat embedding search? Graded relevance eval (9,831 pairs, 164 zh/en queries) over the Agent Skills Hub catalog, with the judge-circularity bias measured.
summary_zh: TypeSafe Jev 重排能否胜过向量检索？在 Agent Skills Hub 目录上做分级相关性评测（9,831 对、164 条中英文查询），并测量了“裁判循环”偏差。

title: jev-experiments
summary: Nader Dabit's collection of small Jev experiments, one per folder: a commit reviewer, a shell guard, a send guard, a log sentinel, instant search, reranking, a voice-turn detector and more.
summary_zh: Nader Dabit 的一组 Jev 小实验，每个目录一个：提交审查、shell 防护、发送防护、日志哨兵、即时搜索、重排、语音轮次检测等。

title: pi-jev
summary: Semantic tool routing and typed System One decisions for the Pi coding agent using TypeSafe Jev
summary_zh: 为 Pi 编码智能体提供语义化的工具路由和带类型的 System One 决策，基于 TypeSafe Jev。

title: typesafe-jev-workflow
summary: A small async LangGraph workflow: each mocked email goes to Jev as a typed Choice (invoice or general) and the graph routes it to a demo handler. Classification makes real API calls; the handlers only set a destination.
summary_zh: 一个小型异步 LangGraph 工作流：把模拟邮件交给 Jev 做带类型的 Choice（发票或一般邮件），再路由到演示处理器。分类会真实调用 API；处理器只设置去向。

title: jlink
summary: Record linkage for economists: write the match rule in plain English, get a probability per pair, audit it, cite it. Python, CLI, Stata and R.
summary_zh: 给经济学家用的记录链接：用自然语言写匹配规则，对每一对记录得到一个概率，可审计、可引用。支持 Python、CLI、Stata 和 R。

title: jsort
summary: sort by meaning: order lines along a plain-English dimension, from pairwise comparisons judged by TypeSafe's Jev model
summary_zh: 按含义排序：沿着一条用自然语言描述的维度给文本行排序，依据是 TypeSafe Jev 判定的两两比较。

title: jev-research-pipeline
summary: Daily research monitor for standing questions: deterministic Python owns the loop, TypeSafe Jev screens sources per question, Qwen writes the notes (pilot)
summary_zh: 针对长期问题的每日研究监控：确定性的 Python 掌控流程，TypeSafe Jev 按问题筛选信息源，Qwen 撰写笔记（试点）。

title: learn-jev-end-to-end
summary: Learn Jev end to end: a free hands-on course. Build 13 AI agent use cases with a fast brain (Jev) and a slow brain (LLM). One OpenRouter key.
summary_zh: 端到端学习 Jev 的免费实践课程：用“快脑”（Jev）加“慢脑”（LLM）构建 13 个智能体用例，只需一个 OpenRouter key。

title: jev-does-not-play-dice
summary: Experiments on Jev’s probability calibration, uncertainty reporting, and forecast probability preservation.
summary_zh: 关于 Jev 概率校准、不确定性表达以及预测概率保真度的实验。

title: hunch
summary: Ask Jev over columns of data: closed-set questions, cached and joined back.
summary_zh: 对数据列向 Jev 提问：封闭集合的问题，带缓存，并把结果连接回原表。

title: jev-browser
summary: One grounded Jev/Playwright core: typed SDK, persistent CLI, and MCP server with native browser operations and deterministic assertions.
summary_zh: 一个基于 Jev 与 Playwright 的统一内核：带类型的 SDK、常驻 CLI，以及带原生浏览器操作和确定性断言的 MCP 服务器。

title: zod-jev
summary: Zod validates the shape; Jev validates the meaning. Semantic checks on a schema — personal data present? price plausible? category matches? — go to Jev in one request and come back as probabilities that become Zod issues.
summary_zh: Zod 校验结构，Jev 校验含义：把 schema 上的语义检查（是否含个人数据、价格是否合理、类别是否匹配）一次性发给 Jev，得到的校准概率再转成 Zod 的校验问题。

title: jev-mcp
summary: An eval-first MCP server for TypeSafe's Jev, a System One model that returns typed judgments (noul, choice, score) with probabilities instead of generated text.
summary_zh: 以评测为先的 TypeSafe Jev MCP 服务器；Jev 是 System One 模型，返回带概率的类型化判断（noul、choice、score），而不是生成文本。

title: jev-mcp
summary: MCP server that puts TypeSafe Jev on the coding loop in Cursor, Codex, and any MCP client
summary_zh: 把 TypeSafe Jev 接入 Cursor、Codex 等任意 MCP 客户端编码流程的 MCP 服务器。

title: jev-playground
summary: Benchmarks Jev against other evaluation models in games with explicit states and legal actions: code owns the rules and transitions, each model picks the next action, and outcomes are measured.
summary_zh: 在状态明确、合法动作清晰的游戏里，把 Jev 与其他评估模型做对比：规则和状态转移由代码掌控，每个模型选择下一步动作，结果可测量。

title: jev-subtitle-translator
summary: Translate SRT subtitles with structured LLM output and check every translation with Jev.
summary_zh: 用结构化 LLM 输出翻译 SRT 字幕，并让 Jev 检查每一条译文。

title: hunch
summary: Probabilistic control flow for Ruby and Rails - powered by TypeSafe's Jev
summary_zh: 面向 Ruby 与 Rails 的概率化控制流，由 TypeSafe Jev 驱动。

title: jev-fanout-bench
summary: Measured: asking TypeSafe Jev N questions in one call bills the state once. 2,976 real requests, raw data, exact billing check.
summary_zh: 实测：在一次调用里向 TypeSafe Jev 提 N 个问题，state 只计费一次。基于 2,976 次真实请求，附原始数据和精确的计费核对。

title: jev-linkedin-slop-filter
summary: Slams a BAIT, CORP or BRAG stamp onto LinkedIn engagement-bait, judged live by Jev (TypeSafe System One).
summary_zh: 给 LinkedIn 上的流量诱饵贴上 BAIT、CORP 或 BRAG 的标签，由 Jev（TypeSafe System One）实时判定。

title: jevloop
summary: A Jev-driven general-purpose agent harness for faster, lower-cost execution, with built-in side-by-side experiments against LLM-only agents.
summary_zh: 由 Jev 驱动的通用智能体框架，追求更快、更低成本的执行，并内置与纯 LLM 智能体的并排对比实验。

title: langchain-skill-router
summary: Per-turn skill selection for LangChain and deepagents agents: a fast judge picks the few skills a turn needs, so a catalog of hundreds stays out of the prompt.
summary_zh: 为 LangChain 与 deepagents 智能体按轮选择技能：由快速的裁判挑出本轮需要的少数技能，让上百个技能的目录不必塞进提示词。

title: localjev
summary: GitHub Next's local, Jev-compatible POST /v1/systemone API in TypeScript, reading probabilities from a DiffusionGemma model through a one-step structured read on a patched vLLM. It reimplements the wire, not the model.
summary_zh: GitHub Next 用 TypeScript 写的本地 Jev 兼容 POST /v1/systemone 接口：在打过补丁的 vLLM 上，通过一步式结构化读取从 DiffusionGemma 模型得到概率。它重新实现的是协议，而不是模型。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: abide
summary: Make your coding agent abide by all your project rules
summary_zh: 让你的编码智能体遵守项目里的所有规则。

title: oko
summary: Code retrieval over MCP for Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode: hands an agent the relevant source snippets so it reads less irrelevant code.
summary_zh: 通过 MCP 为 Codex、Claude Code 与 OpenCode 做代码检索：直接给出相关源码片段，让智能体少读无关代码。
notes: The retrieval benchmark figures in its README (MRR and the comparison with other methods) are the author's own.
notes_zh: README 里的检索基准数据（MRR 及与其他方法的对比）为作者自测。

title: jev-retrieval
summary: Semantic code and document search CLI — BM25 recall + TypeSafe Jev calibrated precision
summary_zh: 语义化的代码与文档检索 CLI：BM25 负责召回，TypeSafe Jev 负责校准后的精确筛选。

title: jeff-cli
summary: jeff, a Go CLI for Jev: from a shell script, give it state and a question with fixed answers and get calibrated probabilities back, with a rank command and meaningful exit codes.
summary_zh: jeff：用 Go 写的 Jev 命令行工具。在 shell 脚本里给它 state 和一个固定选项的问题，就能拿回校准概率；支持排序命令和有意义的退出码。

title: hunch-js
summary: Jev judgments as TypeScript functions over arrays: classify, score, check, where, extract, pick, rank, verify. LLMs propose, Jev decides.
summary_zh: 把 Jev 判断变成作用于数组的 TypeScript 函数：classify、score、check、where、extract、pick、rank、verify。LLM 提议，Jev 决定。

title: mysql-ailike
summary: Natural-language row filtering for MySQL, powered by TypeSafe Jev.
summary_zh: MySQL 的自然语言行过滤，由 TypeSafe Jev 驱动。

title: oxlint-plugin-jev
summary: An oxlint rule that is a yes/no question about a function, call, JSX element or file: each match goes to Jev, and the plugin reports an error when the yes-probability clears your cutoff.
summary_zh: oxlint 插件：一条规则就是针对函数、调用、JSX 元素或整个文件的是非题；每个匹配都交给 Jev，当“是”的概率超过阈值时报错。

title: JevBystander
summary: An Android accessibility reader for WeChat: it only reads the screen and pops three toasts — intent, emotion, urgency, a suggestion — and never writes or sends a reply. No third-party dependencies; an 861 KB APK.
summary_zh: 安卓无障碍版微信判读：只读屏、只弹 3 条 Toast（意图 / 情绪 / 着急 / 建议），不生成回复文案、不发送 · 零第三方依赖，APK 861 KB

title: jev-reranker
summary: Jev-powered relevance filtering and reranking for RAG in Python.
summary_zh: 用 Jev 为 Python 的 RAG 做相关性过滤与重排。

title: pi-jev-router
summary: A minimal Pareto-optimal OpenRouter model router for pi, based on Jev
summary_zh: 为 pi 打造的极简帕累托最优 OpenRouter 模型路由器，基于 Jev。

title: jev-use
summary: Say it, and your Mac does it. A computer-use harness on Jev that reads the screen through Accessibility. Fast, no vision model
summary_zh: 说出来，Mac 就去做。基于 Jev 的电脑操作框架，通过辅助功能接口读取屏幕，速度快，不需要视觉模型。

title: jevify
summary: Supersimple way to serve LLMs as a Jev-like endpoint
summary_zh: 把任意 LLM 以类 Jev 端点形式提供服务的极简方案。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: duckdb-jev
summary: DuckDB extension: typed Jev answers as real SQL types
summary_zh: DuckDB 扩展：把 Jev 的类型化答案作为真正的 SQL 类型返回。

title: Open-Jev
summary: Open-Jev-27B, an open-weight model that returns typed probabilities for a context, questions and candidates without generating an answer — a Jev-style decision model you can run yourself.
summary_zh: Open-Jev-27B：开放权重模型，针对给定的上下文、问题和候选项直接返回带类型的概率，而不生成答案——一个可以自己运行的 Jev 式决策模型。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: jev-cli
summary: CLI for TypeSafe AI's Jev evaluation model — typed questions in, structured JSON answers out
summary_zh: TypeSafe AI Jev 评估模型的命令行工具：输入带类型的问题，输出结构化的 JSON 答案。

title: fast-dev-compaction
summary: Codex plugin: verbatim Jev-guided context restoration around session compaction. Port of tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction to Codex lifecycle hooks.
summary_zh: Codex 插件：在会话压缩前后，由 Jev 引导逐字恢复上下文。移植自 tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction，适配 Codex 的生命周期钩子。

title: jev-mcp
summary: MCP server exposing TypeSafe Jev as typed, calibrated judgment tools: classify, score, check, batched ask. Ships as a Claude Code plugin.
summary_zh: 把 TypeSafe Jev 暴露为带类型、经校准的判断工具的 MCP 服务器：classify、score、check 与批量提问，并以 Claude Code 插件形式发布。

title: ruling
summary: Typed, calibrated decisions from a local model. No text generated.
summary_zh: 由本地模型给出带类型、经校准的决策，不生成文本。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer. Its README's comparison of a local open model with Jev's own answers on public judgments is the author's.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。README 中本地开源模型与 Jev 在公开判例上的对比为作者自测。

title: pi-jev-compaction
summary: Automatic Jev context clearing for Pi. Keep the conversation, prune stale tool output, retrieve originals without rerunning commands.
summary_zh: 为 Pi 自动清理 Jev 上下文：保留对话，修剪过期的工具输出，无需重跑命令即可取回原始内容。

title: decision-bench
summary: Open benchmark runtime for document-grounded decision models
summary_zh: 面向基于文档的决策模型的开放基准运行框架。

title: sqlite3-jev
summary: SQLite extension that calls TypeSafe Jev (or tensai serve) from SQL
summary_zh: 在 SQL 中调用 TypeSafe Jev（或 tensai serve）的 SQLite 扩展。

title: shapeshift
summary: An input that becomes what you mean: one text box that morphs into the right UI as you type. Powered by TypeSafe Jev, works offline.
summary_zh: 一个能变成你想要的样子的输入框：边输入边变形为合适的界面，由 TypeSafe Jev 驱动，可离线使用。
notes: It says it works offline. Jev itself is hosted only, so the offline mode must answer with something other than Jev.
notes_zh: 它称可以离线使用。Jev 本身只有托管版本，所以离线模式回答问题的必定是 Jev 以外的东西。

title: jev-suite
summary: Four decision-quality tools on Jev (TypeSafe System One): Jev answers structured questions, deterministic code keeps the final say.
summary_zh: 基于 Jev（TypeSafe System One）的四个决策质量工具：Jev 回答结构化问题，最终决定权留在确定性代码手里。

title: JevIntent
summary: A WeChat plugin (FkWeChat): long-press a message to analyse its intent, emotion and a suggested reply stance, shown only as a local hint the sender never sees.
summary_zh: 微信（FkWeChat 插件）：长按消息分析意图 / 情绪 / 回复姿态，只在本机弹提示，对方无感知

title: jevgo
summary: Unofficial Go client for the TypeSafe AI System One API (Jev) — typed questions in, calibrated answers out.
summary_zh: TypeSafe AI System One API（Jev）的非官方 Go 客户端：输入带类型的问题，输出校准后的答案。

title: jev-dataops
summary: An open-source JEV-powered workbench for streaming data selection, quality evaluation, automatic LoRA training and held-out model evaluation.
summary_zh: 由 Jev 驱动的开源工作台：流式数据筛选、质量评估、自动 LoRA 训练与留出集模型评估。

title: Jev-X-Sentiment-Analysis
summary: An on-demand crypto market terminal: pick a coin and a tweet sample, and Jev turns market data, funding rates and social sentiment into a Buy, Sell, Hold or Take Profit decision card. It never places trades.
summary_zh: 按需使用的加密市场情报终端：选定币种和推文样本数量，Jev 结合行情、资金费率与社交情绪给出买入、卖出、持有或止盈的决策卡片，不会自动下单。

title: jev-ultralightspeed
summary: Answers one question over a pile of text — tickets, reviews, logs — by packing many items into each request, and reports 32x the throughput of one request per item at 41% lower cost.
summary_zh: 对一大堆文本（工单、评论、日志）批量回答同一个问题：把多个条目打包进每次请求，并称吞吐量是逐条请求的 32 倍、成本低 41%。
notes: The throughput and cost figures come from the project's own benchmark.
notes_zh: 吞吐量与成本数据来自该项目自己的基准测试。

title: jev-ultrafast-mcp
summary: Hand a whole browser task off in one call: a decision model drives the page server-side, so a flow costs one call, not a turn per click. Ref-based element tables, code-checked assertions, zero-model macro replay, over the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
summary_zh: 把整个浏览器任务一次性交出去：决策模型在服务端驱动页面，一个流程只需一次调用，而不是每次点击一轮。基于 Chrome DevTools 协议，提供基于引用的元素表、代码检查的断言和零模型的宏回放。

title: jevcore
summary: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
summary_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness、MCP 与原生 Node 的 TypeSafe Jev 封装：返回带类型的判断而非文字，默认离线。

title: notjev
summary: Super fast Jev like server, model agnostic, working with any OpenAI compatible endpoint
summary_zh: 超快的类 Jev 服务器，与模型无关，可对接任何 OpenAI 兼容端点。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: JevScout
summary: A coding-agent skill that hunts jobs on real company sites: Chrome sees and acts, Jev scores every link and posting, and the host LLM never picks what to click.
summary_zh: 在真实公司官网上找工作的编码智能体技能：Chrome 负责看和操作，Jev 为每个链接和职位打分，宿主 LLM 从不决定点哪里。

title: jev-robot-control
summary: Jev against two LLMs on direct Cartesian control of an xArm7 in MuJoCo — intent, movement and gripper each step — with recorded responses, trajectories and replays. One seed-0 trial per controller, not a success rate.
summary_zh: 在 MuJoCo 中直接对 xArm7 做笛卡尔控制，对比 Jev 与两个 LLM：每一步选择意图、移动方向和夹爪动作，附原始响应、轨迹与回放。每个控制器只跑了一次（seed 0），不是成功率估计。

title: ui-generator-instinct-jev
summary: Jev as a UI generator: describe a case in free text and Jev answers only typed questions over real option sets, picking and configuring an actual shadcn/ui component or page block. It never writes code or copy.
summary_zh: 把 Jev 当作界面生成器：用自由文本描述需求，Jev 只回答基于真实选项集合的类型化问题，挑选并配置真实的 shadcn/ui 组件或页面块，从不生成代码或文案。

title: jev-router
summary: LLM router that picks the cheapest model capable of handling a query, using TypeSafe's Jev for fast classification instead of an LLM call.
summary_zh: LLM 路由器：用 TypeSafe Jev 做快速分类，而不是再调一次 LLM，为每个查询挑出能胜任的最便宜模型。

title: OpenJev
summary: OpenJev: an independent Jev-inspired System One decision API based on TypeSafe.ai concepts. Choice, score and noul primitives, local mock server, Python and TypeScript SDKs. Real inference planned; not affiliated with TypeSafe AI.
summary_zh: OpenJev：受 Jev 启发、基于 TypeSafe.ai 理念的独立 System One 决策 API，提供 choice、score、noul 原语、本地模拟服务器以及 Python 和 TypeScript SDK。真实推理尚在计划中，与 TypeSafe AI 无关。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: typesafe-playground
summary: Community TypeSafe AI playground: 110 use cases, games, dilemmas and model challenges, with editable prompts, A/B comparisons and a mobile-friendly UI.
summary_zh: 社区版 TypeSafe AI 演练场：110 个用例、游戏、两难问题和模型挑战，可编辑提示、做 A/B 对比，并适配移动端。
notes: Community-run despite the account name: TypeSafe AI's own GitHub organisation is typesafe-ai, with a hyphen.
notes_zh: 尽管账号名看起来像官方，但这是社区项目：TypeSafe AI 官方的 GitHub 组织是带连字符的 typesafe-ai。

title: AskJev
summary: AskJev — Jev autopilot for any website + guard on irreversible clicks (TypeSafe System One, not Claude)
summary_zh: AskJev：适用于任意网站的 Jev 自动驾驶，并对不可逆的点击加一道防护（使用 TypeSafe System One，而不是 Claude）。

title: tinyjev
summary: A tiny jev-like model that answers Choice, Score and Noul questions in one forward pass and returns calibrated probabilities. MLX or PyTorch, fully offline, System One compatible.
summary_zh: 一个微型类 Jev 模型：一次前向传播回答 Choice、Score 与 Noul 问题并返回校准概率。支持 MLX 或 PyTorch，完全离线，兼容 System One 接口。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: jev-calculator
summary: A probabilistic AI calculator powered by Jev.
summary_zh: 由 Jev 驱动的概率化 AI 计算器。

title: lejudge-jev-jepa
summary: Natural-language constraints for JEPA world-model planning, judged by a decision model instead of an LLM.
summary_zh: 为 JEPA 世界模型规划写自然语言约束，由决策模型而非 LLM 来判定。

title: second-thought
summary: Learning infrastructure for typed probabilistic decisions from System One models (Laya, and typed-decision providers you bring yourself).
summary_zh: 从 System One 模型（Laya，以及你自带的类型化决策服务）学习带类型概率决策的基础设施。

title: Jevbridge
summary: ACP and MCP adapter that bridges TypeSafe Jev with any LLM — computer use and typed decisions alongside Codex, Claude, Grok, and OpenCode.
summary_zh: 把 TypeSafe Jev 与任意 LLM 连起来的 ACP 与 MCP 适配器：在 Codex、Claude 等旁边提供电脑操作和带类型的决策。

title: jevgrep
summary: Jev-powered semantic code search for coding agents — find behavior across repositories via CLI or MCP, with exact source excerpts and line numbers.
summary_zh: 为编码智能体提供由 Jev 驱动的语义代码搜索：通过 CLI 或 MCP 跨仓库查找某种行为，并给出精确的源码位置。

title: jev-browser
summary: Jev Browser — indexed browser automation. Jev chooses the control, Playwright acts. A CodexQA skill.
summary_zh: Jev Browser：带索引的浏览器自动化。Jev 选择要操作的控件，Playwright 负责执行。一个 CodexQA 技能。

title: milvus-model
summary: A library integrating embedding and reranker models from OpenAI, SentenceTransformers etc for semantic search in vector database.
summary_zh: 把 OpenAI、SentenceTransformers 等嵌入与重排模型集成进来的库，用于 Milvus 等向量数据库中的语义检索；Jev 是其中一个可用的重排器。

title: solar-mini4-jev
summary: A drop-in wrapper that exposes Upstage's Solar models through the Jev System One API shape — noul, choice and score with the same schema — with a hosted bring-your-own-key endpoint.
summary_zh: 一个即插即用的封装：让 Upstage 的 Solar 模型以 Jev System One 的 API 形状对外提供服务——noul、choice、score 使用相同的 schema，并提供自带 key 的托管端点。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: OpenJev
summary: OpenJev: Open-source alternative to TypeSafe Jev. Typed probabilistic decision API (Choice, Noul, Score) powered by open LLMs & constrained logprob calibration.
summary_zh: OpenJev：TypeSafe Jev 的开源替代品。由开源模型驱动的带类型概率决策 API（Choice、Noul、Score）。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: jev-ai-sdk-form-router
summary: Route form submissions to the right people with Jev and AI SDK.
summary_zh: 用 Jev 和 AI SDK 把表单提交路由给合适的负责人。
notes: An example from Vercel Labs, not from TypeSafe AI.
notes_zh: 来自 Vercel Labs 的示例，并非 TypeSafe AI 官方出品。

title: typesafe-go
summary: unofficial go SDK for typesafe AI, with typed answers, retries, and context support
summary_zh: TypeSafe AI 的非官方 Go SDK，支持带类型的答案、重试和 context。

title: system-one
summary: Provider-neutral System One runtime for TypeScript and Pi
summary_zh: 面向 TypeScript 与 Pi 的、与提供方无关的 System One 运行时。

title: laya-server
summary: A self-hosted API and web interface for Laya’s structured decision models, compatible with the TypeSafe Jev API format.
summary_zh: 为 Laya 结构化决策模型提供的自托管 API 与网页界面，兼容 TypeSafe Jev 的 API 格式。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: jev-cua
summary: Voice and text control for macOS. One floating bar, live UI action selection with Jev, and a continuous observe–act–verify loop.
summary_zh: 用语音和文字控制 macOS：一个悬浮栏，由 Jev 实时选择界面操作，并持续执行“观察—行动—验证”循环。

title: jev-cli
summary: Command-line tool for TypeSafe AI's Jev model. Ask yes/no, multiple-choice and rubric questions about any text and get calibrated probabilities back. Answers become exit codes for shells and CI, JSON for scripts, and MCP tools for AI agents.
summary_zh: TypeSafe AI Jev 模型的命令行工具：对任意文本提出是非题、多选题和评分题，并得到校准后的答案。

title: dsh-jev
summary: Jev-powered decision layer for DeepSeek Harness
summary_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的、由 Jev 驱动的决策层。

title: jev-to-answer
summary: A Book of Answers toy: ask a question and Jev picks the answer.
summary_zh: 答案之书jev

title: jev-gmail-ai-spam-filter-and-labeling
summary: Self-hosted AI email classifier for Gmail powered by Jev. Create custom labels, organize your inbox, and filter spam with confidence and cost controls.
summary_zh: 自托管的 Gmail AI 邮件分类器，由 Jev 驱动：创建自定义标签、整理收件箱、过滤垃圾邮件。

title: jev-harness
summary: A custom coding harness for TypeSafe AI's Jev: an LLM proposes, Jev answers narrow questions, code decides, every step leaves a receipt.
summary_zh: 为 TypeSafe AI Jev 打造的编码框架：LLM 提出方案，Jev 回答窄问题，代码做决定，每一步都有记录。
notes: Community-run despite the account name: TypeSafe AI's own GitHub organisation is typesafe-ai, with a hyphen.
notes_zh: 尽管账号名看起来像官方，但这是社区项目：TypeSafe AI 官方的 GitHub 组织是带连字符的 typesafe-ai。

title: jev-mcp
summary: Connect JEV to MCP clients and compare its judgments against general-purpose LLMs using shared datasets and measurable accuracy.
summary_zh: 把 JEV 接入 MCP 客户端，并用共享数据集和可衡量的指标，将它的判断与通用 LLM 进行对比。

title: jev-harness

summary_zh: 面向 Claude Code、Codex CLI 与 Antigravity 的跨智能体安全关卡：拦截 shell 执行、文件写入和补丁，先做快速的本地边界检查，再让 Jev 判断影响范围、可逆性与破坏性。

title: cmd-mod-jev-nudge
summary: Command Code mod: nudges the agent to keep going when it stops with work left, judged by Jev
summary_zh: Command Code 的 mod：当智能体在还有工作未完成时停下，由 Jev 判断后推它继续。

title: llm-typesafe
summary: LLM plugin for accessing Jev and other TypeSafe AI models
summary_zh: 为 LLM 命令行工具访问 Jev 及其他 TypeSafe AI 模型的插件。
notes: By Simon Willison, as a plugin for his `llm` command-line tool.
notes_zh: 作者是 Simon Willison，是他的 `llm` 命令行工具的插件。

title: snapjudge
summary: Typed decisions (choice / score / yes-no) from local Qwen models on Apple Silicon. Probabilities come straight from the logits, no text generation. TypeSafe-compatible HTTP API, runs on MLX.
summary_zh: 在 Apple Silicon 上用本地 Qwen 模型给出带类型的决策（choice / score / 是非），概率直接来自模型。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: pi-jev
summary: Jev-assisted file retrieval and request caching for faster Pi workflows
summary_zh: 用 Jev 辅助文件检索与请求缓存，让 Pi 工作流更快。

title: twitter-jev-guard
summary: Uses TypeSafe Jev to spot low-quality, spam and advertising posts on the X/Twitter timeline and stamps a conspicuous translucent watermark over their text.
summary_zh: 使用 TypeSafe Jev 在 X/Twitter 时间线上识别低质量、垃圾和广告帖子，并在文字区域显示醒目的半透明水印。

title: typed_evals
summary: Fast, typed, calibrated evaluations for LLM and agent outputs, powered by Jev — with simple, framework-agnostic Python APIs
summary_zh: 为 LLM 与智能体输出提供快速、带类型、经校准的评估，由 Jev 驱动，附带简单且与框架无关的 Python API。

title: jeq
summary: What happens when jev meets jq? Intelligence you can pipe for quick experimentation and scripts
summary_zh: 当 jev 遇上 jq 会怎样？可以用管道串联的“智能”，适合快速实验和脚本。

title: ego-jev
summary: Jev (TypeSafe System One) inner loop for ego-browser — one ~0.4s typed decision per DOM step instead of an LLM turn. Agent skill for ego lite.
summary_zh: 为 ego-browser 提供的 Jev（TypeSafe System One）内循环：每个 DOM 步骤一次约 0.4 秒的类型化决策，而不是一轮 LLM 对话。

title: jev-guard
summary: Probability-scored guardrails for Claude Code: deny rule-breaking edits and unasked-for deploys, route your docs into each prompt, and check the final answer against the turn's own evidence.
summary_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供概率评分的护栏：拒绝违反规则的修改和未经要求的部署，并把文档路由到合适的位置。

title: playjev
summary: Fast, typed browser automation powered by Jev and Playwright
summary_zh: 由 Jev 与 Playwright 驱动的快速、带类型的浏览器自动化。

title: jevc
summary: Compile agent policy prose into deterministic verdict programs: narrow evidence questions for the model, the verdict computed in code. Install: npm i -g jev-compiler
summary_zh: 把智能体的策略文字编译成确定性的裁决程序：给模型窄的证据问题，裁决由编译出的代码给出。

title: book-aurora
summary: Jev reads a whole novel in seconds. Every passage becomes a row of colour.
summary_zh: Jev 几秒钟读完一整本小说，每个段落都变成一行颜色。

title: jevmoji
summary: Type anything. Get related emojis scored 0–3 with Jev.
summary_zh: 输入任意内容，得到由 Jev 打分（0–3）的相关表情符号。

title: jev-code-review-benchmark
summary: Comparing Jev, Gemini Flash, and Claude Fable on Python code review rules: cost, speed, accuracy, and consistency. Includes results, charts, and reproducible experiments.
summary_zh: 在 Python 代码审查规则上比较 Jev、Gemini Flash 与 Claude Fable：成本、速度、准确率与一致性。

title: OpenJev
summary: Jev-compatible System 开源Jev
summary_zh: 兼容 Jev 的 System 开源 Jev。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: jev-codex-bridge
summary: Model and reasoning routing for Codex Desktop and CLI, with a Windows service and validated updates
summary_zh: 为 Codex 桌面版与 CLI 做模型和推理力度路由，附带 Windows 服务与经过验证的更新。

title: jev-codes
summary: Audit your git diff against YAML coding-standards packs using TypeSafe's Jev model, from a CLI or your AI agent's command/skill.
summary_zh: 用 TypeSafe Jev 模型对照 YAML 编码规范包审计你的 git diff，可从 CLI 或 AI 智能体的命令中调用。

title: macos-computer-use-kit
summary: AX-first computer use for AI agents on macOS with optional Jev (TypeSafe System One) semantic guards: calibrated target/input judgments before an irreversible action, decisions kept in code. Accessibility-tree targeting, window-scoped input, clipboard-safe paste, read-back verification…
summary_zh: 面向 macOS AI 智能体的、以辅助功能为先的电脑操作工具包，可选配 Jev（TypeSafe System One）语义护栏。
notes: The Jev guards are optional; the computer-use kit works without them.
notes_zh: Jev 护栏是可选项，这个电脑操作工具包不依赖它们也能工作。

title: pijev
summary: PiJev: a terminal coding agent with Jev in the loop — Jev ranks the repository's files before the first call, picks skills and triages failures; your coding model writes the code. Built on Pi.
summary_zh: PiJev：Jev 参与循环的终端编码智能体——在第一次调用前由 Jev 给仓库文件排序，并挑选技能。

title: jev-browser
summary: A hybrid browser harness: an OpenRouter LLM turns goals into verifiable subgoals, Jev chooses each action and form field, the LLM writes text only when a field needs it, and Playwright acts.
summary_zh: 一个混合式浏览器框架：OpenRouter 上的 LLM 把目标拆成可验证的子目标，Jev 选择每一个动作和表单字段，LLM 只在字段需要填写文字时才出场，Playwright 负责执行。

title: dbt_jev
summary: use jev in dbt
summary_zh: 在 dbt 中使用 jev。

title: werr
summary: Zero-memory System-1 decision engine & TypeSafe Jev wire-compatible runtime powered by Mandelbrot wave dynamics (The Zero-VRAM Gauntlet).
summary_zh: 零记忆的 System-1 决策引擎，与 TypeSafe Jev 协议兼容的运行时，由“曼德博波动力学”驱动。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: jevex
summary: A minimal agent in which Jev directs the loop and a LangChain chat model writes only argument values and the final reply, over three local MCP servers with twelve working tools.
summary_zh: 一个最小化的智能体：由 Jev 主导循环，LangChain 聊天模型只负责填写参数和最终回复；背后是三个本地 MCP 服务器、十二个可用工具。

title: reflex
summary: A coding agent and personal assistant with System One reflexes (TypeSafe Jev) on top of the Pi coding agent
summary_zh: 构建在 Pi 编码智能体之上的编码助手与个人助理，拥有 System One 式的“条件反射”（TypeSafe Jev）。

title: jev-browse
summary: Browser automation with Jev (TypeSafe) as decision model
summary_zh: 以 Jev（TypeSafe）作为决策模型的浏览器自动化。

title: SystemOneDotNet
summary: .NET client for TypeSafe System One (Jev) — typed questions in, typed answers with probabilities and confidence out. No prompt engineering, no output parsing.
summary_zh: TypeSafe System One（Jev）的 .NET 客户端：输入带类型的问题，输出带概率与置信度的类型化答案。

title: awesome-jev-use-cases
summary: Explore real-world use cases and projects built with TypeSafe AI's Jev: content moderation, AI agents, model routing, and semantic search. Curated by SeeAPI.
summary_zh: 浏览基于 TypeSafe AI Jev 构建的真实用例与项目：内容审核、AI 智能体、模型路由等。

title: jev-flappy-bird
summary: A live demo of TypeSafe's Jev model playing Flappy Bird, one flap-or-wait decision at a time.
summary_zh: TypeSafe Jev 模型玩 Flappy Bird 的实时演示，每次只决定一件事：扇翅还是等待。

title: jev-slop-guard
summary: Jev Slop Guard — a Chrome extension that scores and stamps AI slop on your X and LinkedIn feeds as you scroll
summary_zh: Jev Slop Guard：一个 Chrome 扩展，在你浏览 X 和 LinkedIn 时为 AI 生成的垃圾内容打分并盖章。

title: wellposed
summary: Lint your jev requests before they come back confidently wrong.
summary_zh: 在 jev 请求自信地给出错误答案之前，先对请求本身做检查。

title: pi-jev-context
summary: Reversible context pruning for Pi, powered by TypeSafe Jev. Keep useful context without deleting session history.
summary_zh: 为 Pi 提供可逆的上下文修剪，由 TypeSafe Jev 驱动：保留有用的上下文，同时不删除会话历史。

title: jev-cloud-quiz
summary: A demo in which Jev judges, with probabilities, which of the three big clouds a feature name belongs to.
summary_zh: 一个演示：由 TypeSafe AI 的 System One 模型 Jev 带概率地判断某个功能名属于三大云中的哪一家。

title: decisions-judge-mcp
summary: Typed decisions for AI agents as an MCP tool: yes/no probability (noul), choice, and score in one fast request. Backed by the TypeSafe System One model.
summary_zh: 把 AI 智能体的类型化决策做成一个 MCP 工具：是非概率（noul）、choice 和 score，一次快速请求完成。

title: jev-php-sdk
summary: PHP SDK for TypeSafe's Jev: send text and typed questions, get typed answers with calibrated confidence. PHP 8.1+, works with any PSR-18 client, Laravel 8–13.
summary_zh: TypeSafe Jev 的 PHP SDK：发送文本和带类型的问题，得到带校准置信度的类型化答案。支持 PHP 8.1+。

title: jev-connector
summary: WordPress connector for TypeSafe Jev: typed, confidence-scored answers your code can branch on.
summary_zh: TypeSafe Jev 的 WordPress 连接器：带类型、带置信度分数的答案，你的代码可以据此分支。

title: typesafe-chess
summary: FUn little experiment with Typesafe AI Jev Model playing chess against stockfish :)
summary_zh: 一个有趣的小实验：让 TypeSafe AI 的 Jev 模型和 Stockfish 下国际象棋。

title: clarity-judge
summary: Multi-axis writing quality checker powered by TypeSafe AI's Jev model. Separate named checks, each with its own verdict and confidence.
summary_zh: 由 TypeSafe AI Jev 模型驱动的多维度写作质量检查器：每项检查独立命名，各自给出结论。

title: jev-mobile
summary: One TypeSafe Jev decision per step over the A11Y tree, executed via ADB. No screenshots and ultra fast!
summary_zh: 在无障碍树上每一步做一次 TypeSafe Jev 决策，通过 ADB 执行。不需要截图，速度极快。

title: s1_ruby
summary: Makes S1-model 'measurement' (and the collapse that follows it) a Ruby primitive.
summary_zh: 把 S1 模型的“测量”（以及随之而来的坍缩）变成 Ruby 的一个基本操作。

title: typesafe-sdk-swift
summary: typesafe-sdk-js and typesafe-sdk-python port for swift
summary_zh: typesafe-sdk-js 与 typesafe-sdk-python 的 Swift 移植版。

title: audio-jevlike
summary: Prosodia: an audio-native Jev-shaped decision model — typed calibrated decisions from speech, no ASR
summary_zh: Prosodia：原生面向音频、形似 Jev 的决策模型——直接从语音给出校准的类型化决策，无需语音识别。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: jev-organize
summary: Throw in a pile of company files and get them classified and organized by department, type, sensitivity, date, counterparty and PII, with an index for AI agents. Powered by TypeSafe's Jev on OpenRouter (17¢ per 1,000 files). Zero-dependency Node CLI + Claude skill + Codex agent.
summary_zh: 把一堆公司文件扔进去，就能按部门、类型、敏感度、日期、交易方等分类整理好。

title: guard-jev
summary: A text-moderation demo: one systemOne call screens seven Noul hazards and one severity Score in parallel, and the verdict is computed in code from policy thresholds.
summary_zh: 一个文本审核演示：一次 systemOne 调用并行检查七个 Noul 风险项和一个严重程度 Score，最终结论由代码按策略阈值计算。

title: typesafe-minecraft-demo
summary: A Minecraft Java player controlled by TypeSafe AI, with live decisions, Canadian flag building, and a side-by-side dashboard.
summary_zh: 由 TypeSafe AI 控制的 Minecraft Java 版玩家：实时决策、建造加拿大国旗，并配有并排的数据看板。

title: jev-screen-mcp
summary: Single-purpose MCP server (one tool, one job): a content-moderation gate powered by TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model).
summary_zh: 单一用途的 MCP 服务器（一个工具，一件事）：由 TypeSafe Jev 驱动的内容审核关卡。

title: typesafe-jev-tools
summary: A Claude Code hook that asks whether the decision you are writing needs a model at all. Includes a measured 149-row comparison of TypeSafe Jev against Claude Haiku 4.5.
summary_zh: 一个 Claude Code 钩子：判断你正在写的这个决策到底需不需要模型。附带一份实测的 149 行对比。

title: jev-skills
summary: Claude Code & Codex skills powered by Jev, TypeSafe's System One model. 256 calibrated judgements for $0.0005 in 0.72s — 360x cheaper than Claude Opus 5. Includes the first published Jev calibration curve, measured on 4,995 real agent decisions.
summary_zh: 由 TypeSafe System One 模型 Jev 驱动的 Claude Code 与 Codex 技能。

title: typesafe-sdk-php
summary: Unofficial PHP library for the TypeSafe API
summary_zh: TypeSafe API 的非官方 PHP 库。

title: dgp
summary: Decision Graph Protocol (DGP) by Numerous ApS: open-source contracts for decision-based AI agents, TypeSafe Jev orchestration, guarded actions, and assessment batching.
summary_zh: Numerous ApS 的决策图协议（DGP）：面向决策型 AI 智能体的开源契约，由 TypeSafe Jev 编排。

title: typesafe-sdk-kotlin
summary: A Kotlin SDK for TypeSafe AI, ported from the official JavaScript SDK with its deviations documented; ask typed questions about text and get typed answers back.
summary_zh: TypeSafe AI 的 Kotlin SDK，移植自官方 JavaScript SDK，并记录了与原版的差异；针对一段文本提出带类型的问题，得到带类型的答案。

title: pi-Jev-browser
summary: Browser and macOS desktop agent for pi: Jev (TypeSafe System One) chooses each action from a structured observation in a bounded, surface-agnostic loop. Isolated Playwright tools, an allow-listed accessibility-tree tool, deterministic selectors, four-tier benchmarks.
summary_zh: 面向 pi 的浏览器与 macOS 桌面智能体：Jev（TypeSafe System One）根据结构化观察选择每一个动作。

title: jev-browser
summary: Jev-powered browser MCP for LLM agents — ~300ms decisions, no LLM tokens in the loop. Benchmark vs Playwright MCP included.
summary_zh: 由 Jev 驱动、面向 LLM 智能体的浏览器 MCP——约 300 毫秒一次决策，循环中不消耗 LLM token，附与 Playwright MCP 的对比基准。

title: JevTest
summary: Bounded exploratory browser testing with Jev, deterministic assertions, and replayable evidence.
summary_zh: 用 Jev 做有边界的探索式浏览器测试，配合确定性断言和可回放的证据。

title: roverlab
summary: A 3D planetary rover sandbox for experimenting with autonomous decisions using TypeSafe AI.
summary_zh: 一个 3D 行星探测车沙盒，用来试验由 TypeSafe AI 做出的自主决策。

title: sift
summary: Chrome extension that re-ranks Google results with TypeSafe Jev and folds away sales pages and SEO filler.
summary_zh: 用 TypeSafe Jev 重排 Google 搜索结果的 Chrome 扩展，并收起销售页面和 SEO 填充内容。

title: jev-review
summary: Autonomous Jev pull-request review with typed decisions, calibrated approval gates, and trusted-owner escalation
summary_zh: 由 Jev 自主完成的拉取请求审查：带类型的决策、校准后的批准关卡，以及升级给可信负责人的机制。

title: jev-acento
summary: ¿Jev entiende tu acento? Pre-registered audit of TypeSafe AI's Jev on Spanish — accuracy, calibration and token cost — plus a CLI to run the same comparison on your own labelled data.
summary_zh: Jev 听得懂你的口音吗？一项预先注册的、针对 TypeSafe AI Jev 西班牙语表现的审计——准确率、校准与 token 成本。
notes: An independent, pre-registered audit of the model outside English — the gap docs/status.md lists as worth watching.
notes_zh: 一项独立、预先注册的非英语审计——正是 docs/status.md 中列为值得关注的空白。

title: ai-hedge-fund
summary: An AI Hedge Fund Team
summary_zh: 一支 AI 对冲基金团队：多个投资者智能体协作做出交易决策；TypeSafe（Jev）是可选的模型提供方之一。
notes: Jev is one of several interchangeable model providers: a native adapter turns its typed answers into the same JSON contract the LLM agents use.
notes_zh: Jev 是多个可互换的模型提供方之一：一个原生适配器把它的类型化答案转换成与 LLM 智能体相同的 JSON 契约。

title: reticle
summary: AI agents can generate code, but still struggle to understand what they build. Reticle brings Jev-style machine-native runtime perception to web & desktop applications.
summary_zh: AI 智能体能生成代码，却仍难以理解自己构建的东西。Reticle 用 TypeSafe Jev 路由验证流程，并由 Jev 驱动对页面的探索。

title: Jevmind
summary: An agent's decisions pulled out of its prose into one place: typed answers with a confidence, behind a gate written in code, sealed in a ledger, graded and learned from. Runs offline on a local rules brain; Jev can be swapped in with one flag.
summary_zh: 把智能体的决策从它的文字中抽离出来集中管理：带置信度的类型化答案，经过用代码写的关卡，封存进账本，被评分并用于学习。默认在本地规则大脑上离线运行，一个开关即可换成 Jev。
notes: Jev is optional here; the default decision engine is local rules.
notes_zh: 这里的 Jev 是可选项；默认的决策引擎是本地规则。

title: 332_lab-jev-chat
summary: A Windows WeChat assistant: Jev judges the intent of each incoming message and DeepSeek suggests replies.
summary_zh: 电脑版微信助手：由 Jev 判断每条消息的意图，DeepSeek 给出建议回复。

title: jevchat
summary: Turns Jev into a chatbot
summary_zh: 把 Jev 变成聊天机器人。
notes: A deliberate inversion: a decision model that generates no text, made to hold a conversation by choosing among candidate replies.
notes_zh: 一次有意的反转：让一个不生成文本的决策模型，通过在候选回复中做选择来进行对话。

title: james_library
summary: R.A.I.N. Lab is an experimental scientific-agent architecture that separates fast local judgment, independent probabilistic evaluation, multi-agent deliberation, evidence, and authorization into distinct computational layers.🐙(Predates Karpathy's AutoResearch)
summary_zh: R.A.I.N. Lab：一个实验性的科学智能体架构，把快速的本地判断、独立的概率判断与推理分离开来。

title: live-jev
summary: Control Ableton Live with one short sentence (Japanese / English). Summon with ⌘⇧Space, type or dictate, done.
summary_zh: 用一句简短的话（日语或英语）控制 Ableton Live。⌘⇧Space 呼出，打字或口述，完成。

title: jev-tree
summary: Jev-native probability tree and graph runtime for verifiable multi-step decision making.
summary_zh: 原生面向 Jev 的概率树与图运行时，用于可验证的多步决策。

title: jev_local
summary: Replicating Jev with a local LLM
summary_zh: 用本地 LLM 复刻 Jev。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: jev-browser-skill
summary: An isolated Playwright Chromium driven by Jev: a coding agent runs a narrowly scoped browser goal and Jev chooses the in-page actions, through the Vercel AI Gateway by default or TypeSafe's API directly.
summary_zh: 由 Jev 驱动的隔离 Playwright Chromium：编码智能体执行一个范围很窄的浏览器目标，由 Jev 选择页面内的操作；默认经 Vercel AI Gateway，也可直接调用 TypeSafe API。

title: Jev_Star
summary: StarCraft II macro and micro with Jev selecting actions and optional LLM planning, with a paper and full recorded winning games.
summary_zh: 星际争霸 II 的宏观运营与微操：由 JEV 选择动作，可选配 LLM 做规划；附论文和完整的获胜对局录像。

title: is-jeven
summary: Is it even? Ask Jev.
summary_zh: 它是偶数吗？问 Jev。
notes: A joke with a point: parity is exactly the kind of arithmetic the vendor lists as a weak spot. Keep deterministic work in code.
notes_zh: 一个有道理的玩笑：奇偶判断正是厂商列为弱项的那类算术。确定性的工作应该交给代码。

title: sys1
summary: System One compatible API for open decision models, e.g. Laya, written in Rust.
summary_zh: 用 Rust 编写、兼容 System One 的 API，面向 Laya 等开放决策模型。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: Jev-Quantum
summary: A Jev-protocol random baseline: it speaks noul, choice and score but reads no prompt, answering from a fast pseudo-random generator — a mock, and a lower bound for routing evaluations.
summary_zh: 兼容 Jev 协议的随机基线：讲 noul、choice、score，但不读提示词，答案来自高速伪随机数——可以当 mock，也可以作为路由评测的下界。
notes: A random baseline on purpose, with a bench against real Jev. Its repository description, a sub-microsecond model with Gaussian accuracy, is the joke.
notes_zh: 这是一个故意做的随机基线，并附有与真实 Jev 的对比基准。仓库描述里“亚微秒级、准确率服从高斯分布”那句是个玩笑。

title: laya-jev-GraphRAG
summary: Agentic GraphRAG engine using swappable System One decision models (local Laya / cloud Jev). Features a complete 4-phase pipeline (Ingestion, Pre-Retrieval, Traversal, Post-Retrieval) and evaluation across Neo4j, Memgraph, Apache AGE, and Kùzu driven by a custom A* traversal algorithm.
summary_zh: 一个智能体式 GraphRAG 引擎，可切换 System One 决策模型（本地 Laya 或云端 Jev）。

title: hookmeter-jev
summary: ⚡ Millisecond-level Viral Hook Telemetry & Co-pilot for Social Media (Chrome Extension + JEV System 1)
summary_zh: 毫秒级的社交媒体爆款开头遥测与辅助工具（Chrome 扩展 + JEV System 1）。

title: MetaCog
summary: Inference-time metacognition: a small, fast judge scores a bigger model's answers and steers its reasoning; Jev is one of the judges it can use.
summary_zh: 推理时的“元认知”：用一个小而快的裁判为大模型的答案打分并引导其推理；Jev 是它可用的裁判之一。
notes: Its default judge is a local 4B model; Jev appears as an alternative judge in the examples.
notes_zh: 它默认的裁判是一个本地 4B 模型；Jev 以替代裁判的身份出现在示例中。

title: snap
summary: Typed decisions from unstructured state: one forward pass, zero generated text. Local, deterministic, Jev-compatible. Not affiliated with typesafe.ai.
summary_zh: 从非结构化状态得到类型化决策：一次前向传播、零生成文本。本地、确定性、兼容 Jev。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.
notes_zh: 这是 System One 接口的重新实现，不是 Jev。接口兼容不代表校准兼容，在 Jev 上调好的阈值不能直接照搬。

title: muse-jev-playbook
summary: Jev decision layer for Muse: a fast, cheap TypeSafe AI gate before expensive agent work — confidence policy, recipes, reference router, honest measurement.
summary_zh: 为 Muse 提供的 Jev 决策层：在昂贵的智能体工作之前加一道快速、便宜的 TypeSafe AI 关卡——置信度策略与配方。

title: a3m-router
summary: ⚡ Adaptive multi-model LLM router — 80+ providers, Jev System One single-pass routing (model=jev-auto), pheromone-trail failover, parallel ensemble merge. npm: adaptive-memory-multi-model-router
summary_zh: 自适应的多模型 LLM 路由器——覆盖 80 多个提供方，用 Jev System One 单次完成路由决策。

title: mario-jev
summary: A prototype that plays Super Mario Bros.: Jev reads structured RAM observations and answers focused questions about moving and jumping, and code turns the answers into controller buttons.
summary_zh: 一个玩《超级马力欧兄弟》的原型：Jev 读取结构化的内存观测，回答关于移动与跳跃的具体问题，再由代码把答案组合成手柄按键。

title: public-browser
summary: Lets Claude Code and Cursor drive Chrome. Browse your real profile: -30% tokens, -25% cost, -41% tool calls, -34% tool defs, +40% faster. Direct CDP, a11y-tree refs, server-side plan executor. MIT, no paid tier.
summary_zh: 让 Claude Code 和 Cursor 驱动 Chrome，使用你真实的浏览器配置，并称能减少 token、成本与工具调用。
notes: The token, cost and tool-call savings are the project's own figures.
notes_zh: token、成本与工具调用的节省数据为该项目自测。

title: jevper
summary: Jev-shaped (TypeSafe System One) classification wrapper over OpenAI-like clients: probabilities and confidence instead of prose

notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.

title: lintus
summary: A linter whose rules are written in plain language.

title: dejevu
summary: Jev? Déjà vu. Browser agents that run on instinct, no Jev needed. One look at the page, one call to any open model, one action. Faster than the Jev demo on Google Flights.
summary_zh: Jev？似曾相识。靠直觉运行的浏览器智能体，不需要 Jev：看一眼页面，调用一次任意开源模型。
notes: A reimplementation of the System One interface, not Jev. A compatible API does not imply compatible calibration, so thresholds tuned on Jev do not transfer.

notes: Jev reads text only, so the multimodal side turns observations into typed state before any question reaches it.
notes_zh: Jev 只读文本，因此多模态部分会先把观测转换成带类型的状态，再向 Jev 提问。

title: jev

summary_zh: 在命令行里做类型化决策：一个非官方的、只用标准库的 Python CLI 与智能体技能，面向 TypeSafe 的 Jev 模型。

title: jev-recipes

summary_zh: 当 TypeSafe Jev 判断意图相同时，跳过昂贵的 LLM 调用。一个兼容 OpenAI 的本地缓存代理。

title: jpp

summary_zh: 面向 AI 评测的验证层：检查的是测量工具本身，而不仅仅是分数——数据、评分器、运行、数字与结论。

summary_zh: DeepSeek 提出下一个 token，由 TypeSafe 的 Jev 来选择：把决策模型用作采样器。

summary_zh: 基于 TypeSafe AI Jev 决策模型的 Go 消息分诊 CLI：为消息归类、给紧急程度打分并决定去向。

title: pi-fast-jev-compaction

summary: Unofficial Symfony bundle for TypeSafe AI's Jev: typed client, validator constraints, Messenger, Workflow guards and profiler panel
summary_zh: TypeSafe AI Jev 的非官方 Symfony bundle：带类型的客户端、校验约束、Messenger、Workflow 守卫等。

title: clay-jev-people-ranker
summary: Agent Skill and Python workflow for Clay lead scoring, B2B prospect qualification, and people-search ranking with TypeSafe JEV.
summary_zh: 面向 Clay 的智能体技能与 Python 工作流：用 TypeSafe Jev 做线索评分、B2B 潜在客户筛选与人物搜索排序。

title: open-jev-bridge
summary: MCP plugin to connect jev-like system one API (local hosted or typesafe jev) to codex and claude code for decision tasks like compaction, verification judgement, etc.
summary_zh: 把类 Jev 的 System One API（本地托管或 TypeSafe Jev）接入 Codex 和 Claude Code 的 MCP 插件，用于决策任务。

title: jev-skill-scout
summary: Finds the turns where Claude Code should have loaded one of your skills and did not, judged by TypeSafe's Jev. Audit CLI plus the mod that fixes it live.
summary_zh: 找出 Claude Code 本该加载你的某个技能却没有加载的那些回合，由 TypeSafe 的 Jev 判断。

title: jevscope
summary: Local-first visual decision debugger and regression testbench for TypeSafe AI Jev
summary_zh: 本地优先的可视化决策调试器与回归测试台，面向 TypeSafe AI Jev。

title: jevmod
summary: Moderation for communities and apps, powered by Jev (TypeSafe): probabilities per category, thresholds you own. Discord/Telegram/Reddit bots, CLI, Python, npm, HTTP API, MCP.
summary_zh: 面向社区和应用的内容审核，由 Jev（TypeSafe）驱动：按类别给出概率，阈值由你掌控。支持 Discord。

title: n8n-nodes-typesafe
summary: Typesafe AI Node for N8N
summary_zh: 用于 n8n 的 TypeSafe AI 节点。

title: JevEye
summary: Ask Jev about an image. A CNN reports what it sees with a calibrated confidence or an abstention; Jev judges what it means.
summary_zh: 向 Jev 询问一张图片：CNN 报告它看到了什么（带校准置信度或选择弃权），再由 Jev 判断这意味着什么。
notes: Jev reads text only; the CNN turns the image into a typed report first, which is the right way round.
notes_zh: Jev 只读文本；由 CNN 先把图像转成带类型的报告，这是正确的分工。

title: deslop
summary: Score web pages for ads, slop, SEO and second-hand content. An agent skill built on TypeSafe Jev: four probabilities per page, no verdict, the caller sets the thresholds.
summary_zh: 给网页的广告、垃圾内容、SEO 和二手内容打分。一个基于 TypeSafe Jev 的智能体技能：每页四个概率。

title: Jevflix
summary: Jev picks, you watch. A hybrid movie recommender: fast semantic + keyword search narrows 4,800 films to a shortlist, then TypeSafe Jev reads your constraints and picks the one film that fits - with a confidence score that decides whether to answer instantly or ask a follow-up.
summary_zh: Jev 来挑，你来看。一个混合电影推荐器：快速的语义加关键词检索把 4,800 部电影缩小成短名单，再由 TypeSafe Jev 读懂你的请求并挑选。
notes: The first catalogued example of the recommendation pattern: retrieval narrows the field, and Jev parses the request's constraints and picks from the shortlist.
notes_zh: 本目录中第一个“推荐”模式的例子：检索先缩小范围，再由 Jev 解析请求中的约束并从短名单中挑选。
